name: OpenAI: GPT-6 Luna Decisions
quirks: A decider: it answers typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) with probabilities and never writes text.
tips: Ask one checkable statement per yes/no question; use a choice question for open questions.
bench: The default look decider in QuorX: median 622 ms per vote, $0.131 per 1,000 votes (224 votes logged), and it settled 78% of screenshot checks on its own.
